ID : ALTEIR_CINE_VISION_URESAIR_v01 · Catégorie : Cinématique

Zone/Scène : Vision d'Uresaïr (cauchemar) · Priorité : P1 · Durée cible : 3:00

Intention (1 phrase) : Oppression liturgique cauchemardesque - la foule tourmente Uresaïr jusqu'à la révélation du masque.

Suno – prompt tags (V5)

- BPM 75 · Mesure 4/4 · Tonalité Phrygian minor

- Palette low cello sul ponticello, hurdy-gurdy drone, tribal frame drum, haunting female choir, dulcimer stabs, bowed metals, waterphone, low brass

- Motif(s) Ostinato 3 notes descendantes (foule oppressante), cluster dissonant (masque/vacuité)

- Autres Attacca opening - entrée brutale subito fortissimo

Suno – lyrics (V5)

- Structure [Attacca], [Choir], [Vocal], [Black Mass], [Interlude], [Screaming], [Climax], [Decay]

[Attaca Choir desperate]
Khova! varesh! khashara!
Vadun zekh! Vadun zekh!
Theomaque! Theomaque nos!

[instrumental]

[Vocal crowd]
Libera nos! Libera nos!

[Choir rising]
Khashara... khashara...
Vadun zekh nos...

[Choir]
Barvas! Karresh! Entropah!
Kosmokrate! Kosmokrate!
Barvas! Karresh! Entropah!

[instrumental]

[Choir frantic]
Theomaque vara! Theomaque vara!
Khova nos! Vadun nos!

[instrumental]

[Choir cacophonic]
URESAÏR! Dragovitsa reject!
Khova varesh nos!
Karresh vadun! Karresh vadun!

[Vocal Vol - cruel authority]
VOID! ETERNAL VOID!
Centuries of rot! Perpetual decay!
Master of failures! Mistress of nothing!
TIME! DEATH! DISSOLUTION!

[Choir building terror]
Theomaque nos! Libera nos!
Vadun zekh! Khashara vara!

[Screaming]
URESAÏR! URESAÏÏÏR!!!
YOU ARE THE MASK!
URESAÏR! URESAÏÏÏR!!!

[Choir]
Kosmokrate! Kosmokrate!
Khova nos! Vadun nos!
Entropah! Entropah absolute!

[Vocal]
Empty vessel! Hollow prophet!
You carry me... you ARE me!

[Climax fortissimo - all voices]
KHOVA NOS! VADUN NOS!
Karresh vadun! Karresh vadun!
THEOMAQUE! STABILITAIRE!
ENTROPAH! ENTROPAH!

[Screaming]
URESAÏÏÏÏR!!!
URESAÏÏÏÏR!!!

[instrumental]

[whispers]
khashara... zekh...
Vara... vara...
Nos... nos...
[whisper]
...uresaïr...

[instrumental]

Suno – paramètres (V5)

- Vocal Gender : Female (choir) + Male (autoritaire/Vol)

- Weirdness : 70% · Cauchemar psychologique

- Style Influence : 65% · Slavic folk horror marqué

- Exclude styles : pop, upbeat, epic, heroic, EDM

- Audio upload : none

- Persona : none

- Inspo : none

Suno – prompt (EN, à coller tel quel)

Dark metal folk opens with eruptions of chaotic percussion and screams. Urgent folk rhythms steer tense verses; choruses erupt into layered folkloric melodies paired with aggressive vocals. The climax fuses martial drums, treated choir, unsettling theremin, and pounding frame drum.

Variantes requises

- Instrumental only · Short loop [30s] ambiance · Stinger [2s] masque tombe

Sorties attendues

- WAV master · MP3 preview · [Stems si dispo]

Intégration

- Event mus/cine_vision_uresair · Snapshot/Bus mix/cinematic · Parameters intensity 0–1
